kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: Barbara Keating died in the 9/11 attack. She's finally being laid to rest
wire.summary: Barbara Keating died aboard one of the planes that hijackers slammed into the World Trade Center. Her remains were finally identified last year, and her family is gathering for a long-delayed funeral.

wire.title: 'I've never seen anything like this' -- A U.S. doctor treats Ebola's youngest victims
wire.summary: Dr. Rupa Narra is a U.S. pediatrician who arrived in the Democratic Republic of Congo to help care for stricken children. Nothing could have prepared her for what she'd face.

wire.title: How did 9/11 reshape national security?
wire.summary: Sept. 11 represented a new kind of national security threat, and a new national security architecture was created to confront it.

wire.title: Trump promises Americans $5K if GOP wins. And, Kirk supporters reflect on his death
wire.summary: President Trump tries to incentivize voters by promising $5,000 to Americans if the GOP wins the midterms. And, young conservatives reflect on the party one year after Charlie Kirk's death.

wire.title: One year after Charlie Kirk's death, Turning Point USA faces an uncertain future
wire.summary: The death of Charlie Kirk was seen as a rallying call for young conservatives. One year later, the movement is wrestling with questions about its future.

wire.title: After Trump promised to pay $5,000 if Republicans win, here's what to expect Thursday
wire.summary: President Trump promised to send every adult citizen $5,000, but only if Republicans maintain control of Congress in the midterm election, setting high expectations for the convention's final night.

wire.title: Scientists say August was Earth's hottest month they've measured
wire.summary: The European climate service Copernicus said the Earth just sweltered through its hottest month on record in August. Scientists said the heat surge is mostly due to human-caused climate change.

wire.title: A pilot of the Amazon cargo plane in Miami crash warned it was coming in too fast
wire.summary: For nearly two minutes, one of the pilots of the Amazon cargo plane that careened off a Miami runway repeatedly warned his counterpart they were going too fast, according to flight information.

wire.title: Fetterman, already at odds with his party, makes surprise video for GOP convention
wire.summary: The Pennsylvania Democrat has already had a strained relationship with many inside his party. In the video, he spoke about working with Trump but did not outright praise him.

wire.title: A huge 11th-century tapestry of the Norman Conquest has (carefully) traveled to England
wire.summary: Part war propaganda, part comic strip, the 230-foot Bayeux Tapestry is back in England for the first time in 900 years. It depicts the 1066 Battle of Hastings, which ended Anglo-Saxon rule.

wire.title: Trump says every adult American will get $5,000 if Republicans win midterms
wire.summary: Speaking at a party convention, the US president gave no details on how the plan would work or where the money would come from.

wire.title: Watch: Is Trump's $5,000 election pledge legal?
wire.summary: The US president has said every American will get $5,000 (£3,700) if the Republican Party wins November's midterms.

wire.title: Iran war won't end until after crucial November elections, says Trump
wire.summary: The president also said oil prices won't come down until after the November races, claiming without evidence that Iran wants to impact the election.

wire.title: Five dead and 86 missing as 'heartbreaking' fire breaks out on Philippines ferry
wire.summary: The fire broke out as the vessel nearing its destination at the tourist hotspot of Coron in Palawan.

wire.title: Royal family rift after popular TV news presenter chosen to succeed Ugandan king
wire.summary: King Oyo's family say he left a will naming his young son as heir to the Tooro kingdom.

wire.title: Twenty-five dead after fire on cargo ship in eastern China
wire.summary: Of the 42 people on board, 17 were were evacuated, CCTV reports.
